mission: 'The AI Safety Fund (AISF) is on a mission to accelerate and expand the field of AI safety research to promote the responsible development and deployment of frontier models, minimize risks, and enable independent, standardized evaluations of capabilities and safety.' It was created by leading frontier AI developers and philanthropic partners and administered by Meridian Institute. Status: Meridian is winding down, and management of the AISF is being transferred to the Frontier Model Forum.

key_work.title: AISF grant programme
key_work.plain_summary: Grants to independent researchers on critical safety risks from frontier models and on preventing malicious use, with a focus on evaluations.

funding_note: Initially $10M+ from Anthropic, Google, Microsoft, OpenAI and philanthropic partners (2023, widely reported); now managed by the Frontier Model Forum.

warnings.text: Frontier models carry critical safety risks and potential for malicious use that need independent study (mission).

recommendations.text: Fund independent, standardised evaluations of frontier-model capabilities and safety (mission).
